notes: v1.18 (internal build 38) - everything from the web edition, same-to-same: the Budget page now has three top views (Plan, Budget, Product Summary) and Expense splits into Fixed and Lifestyle groups, chosen on the List page; number fields no longer show spinner arrows and Calculators is a fourth home card; registration now shows the ten-clause Terms and Conditions (Urdu then English) and the account is created only after Accept; the New Account form takes any bank name and account type you write, with Save disabled until a bank name is entered; Tailor is a new Inventory business type with a per-suit cost and profit line, and every location can be renamed, the shop included; a bilingual User Manual is in the menu and My Devices / My Account are out of Settings; Excel export is rebuilt like the original file with nine sheets and live formulas; the admin Sync switch is honoured (off stops syncing and shows a notice, on resumes without re-login); language modes are strict (Urdu-only shows no English, English-only shows no Urdu) with Jameel Noori Nastaleeq everywhere; face unlock is now available in Settings on devices that have it (Android face/fingerprint, Windows Hello). Your records are never touched by updates: the book format only grows, merges instead of replacing, and records you delete never come back.
